text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's Day. I pay a trip to the
shrine to
pray for Air Shakur's success in
her senior year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished that important task, I
decide to
enjoy a leisurely stroll back to
the academy...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sure, you too.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't that Air Shakur? Even her
regular clothes are
flashy...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if her results will be as flashy as
Opera O's.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's pulling quite a face, but at least
she isn't as
torn up about the gossip as
she was after the
Japan Cup. She seems
a little calmer now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No, I've only just come out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: None of your business.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: How did I know you'd say that...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I don't care what you do, as long as you
don't
hassle me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's probably going to be crowded
anyway. It's not
like one more person's
gonna make it any worse.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But if you come with me, I don't want
you
bugging me about it later. Avoiding
that's half
the reason I'm letting you
come.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This and that. I'm thinkin' I might listen
to a talk
on music or math, or maybe
check out the event
race.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not dragging you around all day.
You can
tag along for one thing. Take
your pick.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sure, that's fine. Just keep it together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur and I check out a casual
outdoor
festival. There are a number of
food stalls and the
atmosphere is festive.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't be here without a reason.
But...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes the music just forces its way
into my
head. On the rare occasions
something resonates
with me, it's
actually quite nice.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ah, there it is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A melodic electronic hum drifts into my
ears. The
fleeting melody almost seems
to dissipate into
the afternoon sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur usually listens to hip-hop, but
it seems
she has a broader taste in music
than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I've discovered how diverse Air
Shakur's
tastes are.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
For real? I'm pretty sure you're not into
that kind
of thing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, it might be just the thing for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur takes me to a math seminar
aimed at
middle and high school
students, delivered by a
famous
mathematician.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There aren't that many chances to see
someone
like him talk in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, he won an award for mathematics.
His work
from around that time is
ridiculously interesting.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm hoping he'll talk about something
interesting,
like his research from that
time or something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears she really respects this
person. And so,
the lecture begins...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That was good. He's just as amazing as I

thought...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. He's really passionate
about
math education, so I bet he takes
that into
consideration.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
He's the complete opposite of my old
man.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
He's a mathematician too—a researcher
to the
very core.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm heading back. I'm glad we
came.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You really want to watch a race on your
day off?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Right...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess it's better than goin'
anywhere else.
Just business as usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a special race today called the
New Year's
Special Event Race, when
Umamusume children
race and then put
on a concert.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Number one's got some legs on her.
Two'd do
better if she worked on her
stamina.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As for three... she needs to change up
her training
methods. Now, if I was
training her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur watches the children as they
try their
best, evaluating each one in
turn. It looks like
she's having fun.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Do I look like I like kids?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't hurt yourself thinking about it. I
don't feel
any particular way about
them.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But running techniques are always
evolving. Even
the racecourses are
changing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's important for me to see it with my
own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Quit it with the cheesy nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Look, it's startin'.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She heads off to finish up her remaining
plans for
the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When she's finished, I suspect she'll
continue her
preparations for senior
year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we start the new year with a
positive
outlook.
